name: Prva imena (Statistični urad Republike Slovenije), tables 05X1005S and 05X1010S
note: Every Slovene first name the register publishes, by sex, with how many people hold it
CC BY 4.0, recorded for SURS on podatki.gov.si; SURS's own copyright page authorises
commercial use and incorporation into other products, requiring the source to be cited
and modifications to be marked. Both are done in NOTICE and in LICENSES/surs-imena.txt.
Marked `authored` for the same reason as SSB: PxWeb answers a POST, so there is no file
to hash. Two tables, one per sex, unlike Norway's single table with the sex folded into
The latest year is taken rather than summed across years. SURS publishes a stock -- how
many people hold the name now -- once per year, so adding the years together would
count the same living person once for every year they were alive.
